title: SB030 · Someone in the water (source scene 23C)
subtitle: Emotion Urgency · two shots, 8 s each · continues from the approved s21-sh04 take (13.6 s) · Ranjith, 2026-11-12

panels.title: Where everyone is (last frame of the take)
beats: Aft view. Antony stands mid-deck near the LEFT rail by the mast and sacks; Babu at the rail a step ahead of him.
Sasi getting up; Raghavan and Aashaan just out of the deckhouse door; the wheel empty.

panels.title: From the deck: a torch light flashes by the fire and goes out
beats: Behind Antony and Babu at the left rail, long lens about 12°: their shoulders soft in the foreground right; the burning vallam 500 m off, left of centre, clearly a boat (a tenth of the frame).
2–5 s a small white torch light swings up twice beside the hull; Antony leans over the rail; Babu shades his eyes.
5–6 s the light goes out. 6–8 s Antony grips the rail; Babu turns to him. Silent. No hand near the camera (L150).

panels.title: Antony shouts to Aashaan (one line)
beats: Low camera just aft of Antony on the port side, looking forward-right; mast, sacks, moon upper right soft behind him; Babu kept out of frame.
0–2.5 s he spins from the rail toward the deckhouse; push-in to MCU. 3.0–5.2 s his line to Aashaan (Malayalam) eyes just right of the lens.
5.2–8 s silent: he points over the rail to the left; the fire tiny at the left edge. Voice Mahendran J.

panels.title: 3D blocking: who stands where
beats: From the take's last frame. Camera for s23-sh04 just aft of Antony on the port side; Aashaan by the door is the one he shouts to; the fire far ahead-left.
